error: The question matters because the teacher says so
shows: Personal purpose is not yet expressed
example: It matters because the teacher says so, beside: It matters because I want to know where my things go
if_many: Offer two classroom uses of an answer and let each child point to the one they would use

error: A rule has no shared purpose
shows: A command is recognized without its shared purpose or consequence
example: Rules are what grown-ups say, beside: The turn rule means both dolls get the glue
if_many: Act the rule with and without it with puppets and name who benefits

error: Listening means sitting perfectly still
shows: Appearance is confused with attending and responding to meaning
example: Listening means sitting perfectly still, beside: Listening means I answer what you said
if_many: Model a response to meaning while sitting, standing and signing

error: We disagree, so one person is bad
shows: Different views are confused with different worth
example: We disagree, so one of us is bad, beside: We disagree about where the plant goes, and both have a reason
if_many: Place two reasons side by side and name agree or differ, without ranking people

error: It is best because it is best
shows: Repetition replaces a supporting reason
example: The rule is good because it is good, beside: The rule is good because it keeps the blocks in the box so the next child can find them
if_many: Point to the pictured result and say because together

error: A child names a fact but never asks why
shows: Asking about a claim needs teaching; not inferred from silence alone
example: The glue is green, when asked to ask why, beside: Why do we take turns with the glue?
if_many: Model asking a why-question about a rule or claim, then children ask one of a fresh picture

error: A rule only applies when an adult reminds me
shows: Independent use of an agreed expectation needs practice
example: I only follow it when the teacher reminds me, beside: I put the glue stick back because the next person needs it
if_many: Rehearse one easy rule with a picture cue, then fade the adult reminder

error: Each person can choose whether a shared rule applies
shows: Public application is treated as an individual choice
example: Each person can pick whether the gate rule counts, beside: The rule about pushing in chairs is for everyone who sits at the table
if_many: Contrast a private choice (which crayon) with a shared rule (the gate)

error: My reply need not connect to what was said
shows: A turn is confused with a response to another idea
example: I want to talk about dinosaurs, in reply to Hang the scarves lower, beside: I agree, then we can reach them
if_many: Match a reply to the idea just heard before exchanging turns

error: I can change a shared rule without telling anyone
shows: Revision bypasses the people sharing the rule
example: I can change the rule without telling anyone, beside: We all agree to try a change
if_many: Model asking the class and the teacher first, then trying the change

error: Different classmates share no needs
shows: Different preferences obscure common needs in a shared room
example: The two classmates share nothing, beside: One likes the reading corner and one likes the water table, and both need space and a turn
if_many: Lay two picture cards of different activities side by side and ask what the table, the room and the light do for each

error: A child is asked why and repeats the claim without a because
shows: Answering about a claim needs teaching; not inferred from silence alone
example: Asked why, a child repeats Take turns, beside: Take turns, because both can reach the book bin
if_many: Model answering with because, then swap roles on a fresh claim

error: I started, so my job is finished
shows: Starting is confused with completing a responsibility for others
example: I watered the plant, so my job is done (the jug still across the walkway), beside: My job is done when the jug is back and the walkway is clear for others
if_many: Put an unfinished job beside a finished one with two puppets, then finish a new shared job together

error: Voting means everyone wants the same thing
shows: A fair shared decision is confused with unanimous preference
example: We voted, so everyone wanted the same, beside: Two ways got blocks; one had more; we try it and keep the other idea on the record
if_many: Hear reasons, look for what both can accept, one block each, keep both ideas visible after the result

error: We chose it, so it worked
shows: A decision replaces evidence of its effect
example: We chose it, so it worked, beside: The walkway has room now; the before and after pictures show it
if_many: Write a specific next step on each card; repeat as a day nineteen group that compares a before and after detail

error: The biggest character is the responsible one
shows: Appearance or power replaces evidence of conduct
example: Pia is caring because she is the biggest, beside: Pia is caring because she shared her paper with Isa
if_many: Point to an action, cover faces and sizes, say what the action shows

error: Following a rule means making it
shows: Agreement on a rule and acting under it are not distinguished
example: Nell made the clear-table rule by clearing the table, beside: The class agreed to clear the table (making); Nell cleared it (following)
if_many: Lay the agreeing scene and the following scene side by side and sort a new pair

error: It helps because it helps
shows: A repeated claim replaces evidence and a reason
example: It helps because it helps, beside: It helps because the basket moved and there is room to pass
if_many: Point to a source detail and connect it to a claim with because

error: The loudest person can choose without hearing others
shows: Dominance replaces a cooperative process
example: A puppet says I am picking, I do not need to hear you, beside: Tell me why, then we look for a way you can both accept
if_many: Puppets give each reason before anyone decides

error: Helping lets me take another person's materials without asking
shows: Helpful intent is confused with respect for others' choices
example: A puppet grabs the marker box from a puppet who is using it, to help, beside: May I have the box when you are done?
if_many: Practise asking before moving shared materials, puppets first, then partners

error: People who disagree with the decision are bad
shows: Dissent is treated as wrongdoing
example: The red puppet wanted the other way, so the red puppet is wrong, beside: its reason stays on the record; we check later
if_many: Put the dissenting reason beside the plan, no names ranked

error: Choosing a plan is the same as carrying it out
shows: Decision is confused with action
example: We picked it, so it is done, beside: We picked it, then we moved the basket
if_many: Match each chosen step to an action with picture cards
